description: SPI-NOR bootloader layout for the SpacemiT K3 pico-itx (boots from NOR). Offsets MUST match the K3 FSBL/SPL build (vendor partition_4M.json): the FSBL is ~455K so it needs the 512K slot, and env/opensbi/uboot sit after it. Android lives on UFS (partition_android.json).

partitions.name: bootinfo
partitions.comment: BROM FSBL address/size descriptor; MUST stay at offset 0

partitions.name: fsbl
partitions.comment: offset designated by bootinfo; 512K slot for the ~455K FSBL

partitions.name: env
partitions.comment: U-Boot env; MUST not change its offset/size
